title: Is Online Shopping Taking Over Everything?

scenes.narration: It feels like everything is bought online today.

visual.text: Is Online Shopping Taking Over Everything?

scenes.narration: But look at the reality of retail sales.

visual.text: The reality of retail is surprising.

scenes.narration: As of April 2026, online shopping is just 17.1% of total retail sales.
That means over four out of five dollars are still spent in physical stores.
The full story is on the channel.

title: The Massive Growth of Digital Commerce

scenes.narration: How much has online shopping really grown?

visual.text: The Massive Growth of Digital Commerce

scenes.narration: In January 2000, online retail was just 0.8% of the market.
Fast forward to April 2026, and that share has exploded by 2038%.
Digital storefronts are now 21.4 times larger than they were at the turn of the millennium.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Why Physical Stores Are Still Winning

scenes.narration: Why do physical stores still dominate the retail landscape?

visual.text: Why Physical Stores Are Still Winning

scenes.narration: Total retail and restaurant spending reached $745 billion in September 2026.
While online sales hit $124.3 billion, traditional stores hold the massive majority.
Shoppers still crave instant gratification and in-person inspection.
The full story is on the channel.
